title: הונא בר תחליפא

paragraphs: Huna bar Tachlifa (see his entry), in Rava’s name: Yevamot 8b; Niddah 26a; Bava Metzia 35a. Kiddushin 71, end of side a, “in Rav’s name,” is a scribal error and should read Rava, for his father Rabbi Tachlifa reported Rava (see his entry). See Rabbi Anan bar Tachlifa. In my opinion this misled Sheerit Yosef into counting him among Rav’s students. Rav Rechumai said in Rav Huna bar Tachlifa’s name; see there. In Rav Pappi’s time (I did not find it).
